notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 600 x 400, the grid 60 / 40 / 40 / 40; animation false unless the case says.
a static case paints (renderToSVGString) after setOption and after every step; its timers settle 500 ms before and after every step.
an animation case samples the clock at samplesMs after each setOption; a {wait} step only lets the clock run.
renderItem: '@name' is the recorder of RENDER[name]: the params, every api call and its answer, the tree returned.
ids an author did not write are upstream's with \0 written ~; a Date in the params is {}.
TZ=UTC: the calendar's times are UTC midnights.

cases.note: sectors on a polar: coordSys {cx, cy, r, r0}, api.coord's [x, y, radius, angle], api.size with a data item (px on the value radius, the category band in radians), barLayout undefined; a hover
calendar days: coordSys {x, y, width, height, cellWidth, cellHeight, rangeInfo}, api.coord of a bare date, api.layout's rect and contentRect; a date past the range is NaN and draws nothing
dots on a single axis: coordSys {x, y, width, height}, api.coord and api.size of bare values (a number back)
dots on a CATEGORY single axis: api.size is the band width whatever the value asked (milestone C14-C22)
coordinateSystem 'none': no coordSys, the dimensions x and y, the values as pixels; a hover

api.visual over a continuous visualMap (colour, symbolSize and opacity mapped; api.style's opacity) and a piecewise one (a piece's colour as written, a piece's symbol); the visuals nothing sets undefined

enter: the root's enterFrom (y) and the style's (opacity) with an enterAnimation (800 ms linear, delay 100), a shape's enterFrom (r) on the series' timing (1000 ms cubicInOut, animationDelay 40), a group scaled in with its children

update after a data change: the default transition ['x', 'y'] (the shape jumps), 'all' (the transform, the shape, the animatable style), per-prop lists (root x, shape r, style fill), the words 'shape' and 'style' with an updateAnimation (300 ms linear), the series' animationDurationUpdate 700 and quadraticOut; a new item enters as it is; a second change removes four items at once
a removed item whose element has a leaveTo: applyLeaveTransition reads customInnerStore(el).option, which CustomView never sets -- the render throws after updating the items before it
the same with the animation off: the throw does not depend on it

the root's focus and blurScope: 'self' (the default scope, the coordinate system) blurs its own series but the hovered item and the other series of its grid, not the series on the second grid; 'series' with blurScope 'global' every other series, the second grid's too; none blurs nothing; emphasisDisabled: no hover at all
tooltipDisabled: on a root, on one child of a group (its sibling still shows the tooltip), on a group (its child hides it)
coordinateSystem null: no coordSys (the key the option has keeps the default out), as 'none'; a hover

api.visual('visualMeta'): a continuous visualMap (201 stops, outerColors the end stops), a piecewise one (each finite piece two stops in its colour as written, an open end an outer colour, an end nothing colours ''), a continuous one with a narrower range and an outOfRange colour; the second series none: []
clip: true on a polar: createPolarClipPath's sector (the centre and radii to one decimal, the angles turned) -- a sector past the radius axis' max is cut there; an anticlockwise polar beside it

during on custom elements: getElementAnimationConfig binds it on the enter (the series' timing above 0) and on an update with the default transition ['x', 'y']; a circle's r and opacity follow its extra

clipPath on custom elements: a rect cut to a circle (the pointer outside the circle misses it), a group cut to a rect (its child and text cut, the pointer past the clip misses); then an update growing the circle and giving the group clipPath false (removed: the pointer there hits)
